CLASH OF KINGDOMS

⚔ Personal Goals & Rewards

Choose your troop level to open its complete personal-goal ladder. Goal points are cumulative totals over the run.

Shared ladder rules

  • Each troop level has one long ladder combining all six regular leagues and seasonal goals.
  • Each ladder includes 3 Honor Token goals (140 tokens total) and 7 Portal goals (160 Portals total). Troop Level I–II has six Conquest point goals and no repeating Conquest goals.
  • From Troop Level III, the ladder also includes 10 repeating Conquest point goals and a top goal of 10 Artifact Summoning Keys.

EPIC MONSTER CHESTS

🐉 Kill chest breakpoints

Choose a monster to open its own full-screen reference page, with its chest source, squad details and breakpoint table.

How the kill chests work

  • A full kill pays a set number of chests, event points and Experience.
  • A partial kill earns the same share of all three, with chest rewards arriving at each breakpoint.
  • Points are event points and are not changed by player bonuses. Experience is the monster's base amount before player bonuses.
  • Kill chests are clan chests; their contents are not listed here.
  • Doomtree and Epic Jörmungandr are raids. Each member's chest share follows their own contribution.
  • Seasonal epic monsters and Ragnarök bosses use the same squads and chests in home kingdoms, so the breakpoints apply there too.
